why_cohort_rebuild_first: The bucket cohort MTs are chr22-ONLY (Gate C's smoke overwrote the production mt_{ancestry}_qc.mt paths; the final checkpoint is not interval-isolated). AOU-2 (LD) reads them directly and dev-10/production regions span all autosomes -> LD would skip every region. So cohorts must be rebuilt genome-wide first. This is the first full-scale run of the now-fixed pipeline (m3-W1 was the FAILED genome-wide attempt; Gate C proved the fixes on chr22). ETA ~3-6h, EUR the long pole.
